featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience. I ordered a fresh lime juice and found plastic particles in it. When I brought this to the attention of the person at the counter, he refused to acknowledge the issue despite being shown the particles clearly. He initially claimed that it was lemon pulp, but upon closer inspection and tearing it apart, it was evident that it was plastic.

What was even more concerning than the contamination was the unwillingness to accept responsibility or address the complaint seriously. Basic hygiene and customer service standards were completely lacking. I would not recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: PinnedCloud
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a really enjoyable time here. The three of us visited on a Thursday and initially thought the place was empty, but then realised most guests were seated outdoors, February weather makes it perfect for that.

Here’s what we ordered:

• Burrata & Rucola Salad – Very good
• Spaghetti Arrabbiata – Excellent sauce and lovely handmade spaghetti (would’ve preferred it not broken up though)
• Spaghetti Pomodoro – Very good
• Penne Pesto – Very good
• Ginger Lemon Kombucha – Good
• Golden Latte – Good
• Cortado – Very good (and loved the cup!)
• Flourless Pure Chocolate Cake – Absolutely delicious

They make their own pasta and bread, which really shows in the quality and freshness of the dishes.

The staff were warm and friendly, service was efficient, and the overall vibe is relaxed and inviting.

The only downside is the location, it’s on a very busy street, which makes getting there on a weekday evening a bit challenging. Hopefully they expand to other parts of Mumbai soon!

featured_reviews.name: Rudrakshi Nalavade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Nude Food Café as a group of five and, unfortunately, the experience didn’t go as well as we hoped. Although we were told the wait would be around 20 minutes, we ended up waiting 1.5 hours for a table, while others seemed to be seated much faster. The staff and owners were polite, but the communication about wait times needs improvement, and there were no proper waiting arrangements.

On the positive side, the café has a great eco-friendly concept with a zero-waste food policy, which I really appreciate. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, even though the space feels a bit small and crowded.

The coffee was excellent, the chicken pie was tasty (could’ve used a spicy note), and the pasta dishes were nice, though one was slightly undercooked and could have used more spice. Portions felt a bit small for the price.

Overall, while the café’s concept and ambience are lovely, the extremely slow service and long wait time took away from the experience. Expanding the seating area or managing reservations more clearly would help a lot.
